ns2:course.label: Art in the Elementary Grades
ns2:course.description: Introductory laboratory experiences with the elements of design in the visual arts and with processes, materials, and activities appropriate for the elementary grades. Class Materials Fee of $30 required. See Class Schedule. Not open to students majoring in art and design.
